posts.author: Ms_Zael
posts.body:
Hi! This is my first post here, hope is the correct section.
I'm a beginner in rpgmaker in general and this is my first time trying to make a project. I just did the tutorial inside rpg maker mz and we'll, played a lot of rpg maker games.
So I need help for what I'm trying to do.
The project I have in mind is something just for fun of it, I don't have plans on posting it somewhere or anything.
The game should be an adaptation of a ttrpg oneshot I had with some friends a while a go. Is in a homebrew sci-fi setting where the characters were mecha pilot in a mission for a  corporation...I don't what to annoy you with the details.
Im looking for some free assets for the project, like tileset, sprite, battlers, maybe music ecc.
And also some mechanical help for this questions:
Is there a way to add new resources bar? Like I already changed the names, for example MP-> Energy -EN and so on, but is there a way to add one more other the default MP and TP?
Another question, is there a way to make a skill work for some allies specifically? For example I want a repair skill that cures only Robots but not People
And another one, is there a way to have to separate party? I wanted to make a party with the pilots and a separate party with the robots. With that I want to archive the menu option to manage the equipment of the pilot and robot separately (they are different actors)
I want to thanks in advance anyone who replies to this post and I ask apologies for my English, is not my first language

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
There's a Himeworks plugin that lets you have multiple parties. It should work in MZ too
Party Manager
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xh-QNPh4t0QIn RPG Maker, you have a "party". A party consists of a group of actors, an inventory of items, weapons, armors, and gold, and potentially some other inf

posts.author: static_remains
posts.body:
Hmmmmm it's a little tricky finding free resources when I don't know what kind of vibe you're looking for, but judging by the robots I found some sci-fi stuff ? LOL
Free space tiles by Kauzz:
https://kauzz.itch.io/ft1
More free space by Kauzz:
https://kauzz.itch.io/ft2
Free nostalgia pixel style sprites by Oceans Dream:
https://oceansdream.itch.io/nostalgia-mz-heroes
Free modified MZ sprite generator by Despair Party:
https://despairparty.itch.io/rpg-maker-candymold
For plugins in general, I'd recommend taking a look at the VisuStella sample game project and seeing if you'd find any of those useful, they're free as long as you follow their terms of use:
VisuStella sample game project:
https://visustella.itch.io/visumz-sample
Further info + terms of use:
http://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/VisuStella_Sample_Game_Project
Lastly, I'd just poke around on itch.io + this forum for resources, you can find good music on youtube too (just make sure you follow terms of service and credit the creators) - plus, the default tiles included in MZ are good imo
Can't think of anything else for nowwwww.........
Welcome to the forum + good luck with the game dev !!!!!
